desc: Implement and validate the sliding-window bitmask transition for clear and blocked positions.
Prove and handle acceleration of long clear gaps, including the \(A<B\) stabilization case and \(A=B\) periodic case.
Process sorted blocked intervals, preserving jumps that cross bad segments.
Handle initialization at square 1, final square N, and edge cases such as M=0.
Produce the final Python solution and verify it against all public samples.
